semantic_law: For TWO finite ground, ordered, free first-order constructor terms (not D2 executable expressions), return their least general generalization modulo alpha-renaming and two substitutions which reconstruct each term EXACTLY. Identical atoms and equal-name/equal-arity constructors are retained. Every incompatible ordered pair of subterms becomes one fresh hole; equal ordered disagreement pairs reuse the SAME hole, even in disjoint branches. A different arity or constructor is a disagreement. Fresh holes are numbered by first depth-first left-to-right appearance. A non-ground input, binder, improper term or unbounded depth is BLOCKED. This operation is not unification and never claims a physical .sens semantics.

positive_witnesses.meaning: Repeated ordered disagreement uses exactly one hole, not two independent variables
Swapped difference pairs are not the same ordered pair
Astronomy schema retains shared star and band constructor

falsifiers: A procedure that assigns two holes to identical ordered disagreement pairs is too general
A procedure that shares a variable between (a,b) and (b,a) loses ordered relationships
A procedure that discards shared constructors is not least-general
A procedure that reconstructs only one source or drops the second substitution is insufficient
A procedure that treats differing constructor arities as equal is unsound
A procedure that interprets Lisp binders or Text7 frames as freely substitutable constructors violates the bounded contract

comparison.unify: Solves substitutions making two terms identical and may FAIL on different constants; LGG generalizes incompatible terms and succeeds on ground terms
comparison.abduction: Finds hypotheses entailing observations under theory/integrity constraints, not a syntactic structural common generalizer
comparison.atms: Tracks support/environments for beliefs rather than variable-sharing least general schema
comparison.inductive_library_derivation: May be implemented as a reusable library atop lists/equality/memo; owner must decide if independent D10 resident is justified
comparison.known_interest_proposal_unify: UNIFY is the dual problem, NOT a semantic duplicate; no selection follows from this name check
